_doc: Measured once, reused until something changes (Specification §5.2 'standard' data class). The explorer shows when each was last checked.

items.label: What it is
items.value: A yoga mat towel/cover, placed directly on top of a conventional yoga mat. Not intended to be used as a standalone yoga mat.

items.label: Construction
items.value: Face: hemp warp with weft strips cut from reclaimed post-consumer sari fabric. Backing: handwoven hemp cloth, no artificial dyes. Bound edge with knotted fringe at both short ends. Natural fiber with reclaimed materials.

items.label: Loom type
items.value: Traditional handloom, no electricity (weaving stages). Sewing during finishing may use electricity.

items.label: Primary textile inputs
items.value: Natural hemp yarn about 650 g; reclaimed sari fabric about 484 g; combined about 1,134 g (about 61.5% hemp / 38.5% reclaimed sari by weight — percentages of the two principal inputs, not of the finished product).

items.label: Care
items.value: Gentle machine cycle and air-dry; hand-washing recommended for longer-lasting care.
